Maple Finance is a DeFi lending protocol that provides undercollateralized loans to institutional borrowers. Maple Finance operates on public blockchains through smart contracts. Maple Finance uses lending pools that are managed by pool delegates. Maple Finance is governed through its MPL token.

Sushiswap is a decentralized exchange that uses an automated market maker model. Sushiswap was forked from Uniswap. Sushiswap is governed by holders of its SUSHI token. Sushiswap operates across multiple blockchains that support smart contracts.
